text: University of Michigan consumer sentiment fell to a new record low as inflation expectations increased across both short-term and longer-term horizons. Elevated oil prices and Strait of Hormuz supply disruptions remained active conditions alongside rising Treasury yields and reduced expectations for Federal Reserve rate cuts. Financial markets continued repricing around persistent inflation risk.

meta.note: Consumer expectations and monetary-policy assumptions continue adjusting without convergence.

text: Kevin Warsh was sworn in as Federal Reserve chair during a White House ceremony attended by executive, legislative, and judicial officials. The transition occurred amid continued disagreement between market rate expectations, presidential preferences for lower rates, and persistent inflation conditions. Jerome Powell remained on the Board of Governors following the leadership transfer.

meta.note: Institutional continuity and executive proximity coexist within the same monetary-governance structure.

text: Tulsi Gabbard announced her resignation as director of national intelligence effective June 30, with Principal Deputy DNI Aaron Lukas designated as acting successor. The leadership change followed prior public disagreement between Gabbard and President Trump over Iran-related intelligence assessments and military posture. Multiple senior administration departures and removals remained active within the executive branch structure.

meta.note: Personal withdrawal and institutional leadership instability overlap within the same executive structure.
